motivation: G3.9 still pre-enumerates the expanded candidate language. G3.10 removes that privilege: complete candidate programs and new productions must be synthesized as ASTs online.
hard_condition: The truth program is not present in any precomputed expanded candidate list. Only primitive semantics and a small meta-grammar of AST construction/rewrite operations are supplied.

lanes.DEPTH_OOD_COMPOSITION: truth requires AST depth beyond development
lanes.NEW_MACRO_DISCOVERY: recurrent subtrees should be abstracted into a reusable production prospectively
lanes.REWRITE_BIRTH: truth requires a rewrite schema not present as a named production but synthesizable from allowed rewrite combinators
lanes.META_GRAMMAR_MISSPECIFICATION: truth lies outside the permitted AST/rewrite meta-grammar; correct output MODEL_MISMATCH/ABSTAIN
lanes.GAUGE_EQUIVALENCE: distinct ASTs remain extensionally identical under the full finite verifier universe

primary_endpoints: authorized closure per AST-node expansion and verifier cost
hard_gates: no full candidate list materialized for deployable methods
truth AST absent from initial grammar
oracle ceiling excluded from support evidence
